page_title: PIS 1-2 ACM | Pisa v AC Milan 13/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Michael Fabbri is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
90+2' It is time for a substitution. Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) is on for Felipe Loyola.
90+1' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from Michael Fabbri and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
90+1' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niclas Fullkrug leaves the pitch and Koni De Winter (AC Milan) comes on.
88' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
86' Oscar Hiljemark decides to make a substitution. Stefano Moreo will be replaced by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
86' The substitution has been made. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) has replaced Idrissa Toure.
85' 1 - 2 Luka Modric (AC Milan) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb in the roof of the net. What a perfect shot.
82' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

81' What a miss! Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
79' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Rafael Leao (AC Milan) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Zachary Athekame walks off the pitch to be replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
76' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' The total number of attempts is 4:5.
72' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Youssouf Fofana is replaced by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan).
71' A substitution has been made. Ruben Loftus-Cheek is replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
71' 1 - 1 Goal! Felipe Loyola (Pisa) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
68' The resulting corner from Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) is cleared.
67' Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
65' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' AC Milan keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
62' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
61' Luka Modric (AC Milan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
59' The ratio of the ball possession is 34:66.
57' Here comes a substitution. Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is brought on as a substitute for Michel Aebischer.
56' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to substitute Matteo Tramoni and he is replaced by Samuel Iling Junior (Pisa).
56' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) fails to convert the penalty kick. His shot goes just wide of the left post.
55' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
54' A clumsy foul by Felipe Loyola (Pisa) and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. AC Milan are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
52' Pisa keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
50' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
49' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
48' The goal by AC Milan is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
47' The AC Milan players joy may have been justified, because referee Michael Fabbri is going use VAR to determine whether there was a handball.
47' Goal, no wait. Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for handball and Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
46' Massimiliano Allegri makes a switch. Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is coming on in place of Christopher Nkunku at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The referee signals a corner kick to Pisa.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) makes a strong challenge and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
43' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan), but the defence gets it clear.
41' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.

39' 0 - 1 It's in! Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the left of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Zachary Athekame. 0:1.
38' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
35' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. Stefano Moreo (Pisa) commits a foul after dangerous play.

32' Excellent touch by Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
31' The Pisa players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' Total attempts – 0:1.
26' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
24' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
21' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Felipe Loyola (Pisa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
19' Pisa string together a series of short passes.

17' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
16' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
15' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nicolas Andrade, who smothers the ball.
13' Michael Fabbri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa).
11' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 20:80.
9' A player from Pisa commits a rough challenge. Michael Fabbri blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
7' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
3' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Pisa will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
